nodes.body:
# Constraint

Files under `.amta/generated/` are generated by `amta build`. Manual edits belong in source nodes, not generated output.
nodes.summary: Generated AMTA files are reproducible outputs and must not be edited manually.
nodes.title: Generated Artifacts Are Read-Only

nodes.body:
# Context

Markdown remains the human authoring interface, but the generated graph is the source of truth for validation, automation, and derived artifacts.

# Decision

AMTA Core treats parsed node models and the generated graph as canonical. Generated outputs must not be edited manually.
nodes.summary: AMTA uses a validated graph as the canonical operational representation.
nodes.title: Graph as Source of Truth

nodes.body:
# Scope

This module owns Markdown frontmatter parsing, node normalization, and domain model validation.
nodes.summary: Parses Markdown nodes into validated Pydantic models.
nodes.title: Parser and Model Layer

nodes.body:
# Scope

This module owns relation integrity checks, graph construction, manifest generation, state generation, roadmap generation, and changelog generation.
nodes.summary: Validates graph integrity and generates deterministic artifacts.
nodes.title: Validator and Builder Layer

nodes.body:
# Task

Harden packaging, public CLI behavior, documentation, and example workspaces before the first reusable release.
nodes.summary: Prepare AMTA Core for use as a reusable library across projects.
nodes.title: Prepare Reusable Library Release
